verdict.rationale: A probe confirms developer.nvidia.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a real summary, showing NVIDIA does expose an agent-readable entry point for its developer docs, but this is a generic portal file, not specific to H200 GPU documentation, and other agent-friendly formats (docs.md, OpenAPI) return 404s. Missing for 10: H200-specific machine-readable docs, working docs.md/OpenAPI endpoints, and confirmation an agent can navigate beyond the root llms.txt.
